mapper.select: SELECT FOUND_ROWS() AS CNT , RESULT_TB.* FROM( SELECT @BOARD_ROWNUM := @BOARD_ROWNUM + 1 AS RNUM , mur.mbid , mm.adj_yn , CASE WHEN (mur.mb_status IN ('04', '05') AND mm.adj_yn = "N") THEN '401' WHEN (mur.mb_status IN ('04', '05') AND mm.adj_yn = "Y") THEN '402' ELSE mur.mb_status END AS mb_status , DATE_FORMAT(mur.mb_request_date,'%y/%m/%d') AS mb_request_date , cu.USER_NM , cu.FIRM_NM , CASE WHEN (mur.mb_product_code = 'MP') THEN '머니플러스' ELSE '' END AS mb_product_code , TRUNCATE(TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, cu.FIRM_SETUP_DATE, NOW()),1) AS periodYear , SUBSTR(TRUNCATE(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MONTH, cu.FIRM_SETUP_DATE, NOW())/12,1), -1) AS periodMonth , TRUNCATE(mur.mb_sales_amount/1000,0) AS mb_sales_amount , IFNULL(TRUNCATE(ppr.prizm_score, 0), '-') AS prizm_score , IF(IFNULL(ppr.prizm_score, 0) > 500, '승인', '거부') AS prizm_accept , mm.fee_rate AS fee_rate , mm.payment_rate AS payment_rate FROM MONEYBANK_USER_REQUEST mur LEFT JOIN CBCI_USER cu ON mur.user_code = cu.USER_CODE LEFT JOIN MONEYBANK_MONEYPLUS mm ON mur.mbid = mm.mbid LEFT JOIN PRIZM_PCS_RESULT ppr ON ppr.mbid = mur.mbid , (SELECT @BOARD_ROWNUM := 0) ROWNUM_TB WHERE mur.mb_status IN (${status}) AND UPPER(cu.USER_NM) LIKE UPPER('${userNmSearch}%') AND UPPER(cu.FIRM_NM) LIKE UPPER('${firmNmSearch}%') AND UPPER(cu.USER_ID) LIKE UPPER('${userIdSearch}%') AND UPPER(mur.mb_product_code) LIKE UPPER('${selectDivSearch}%') AND mur.mb_request_date >= #{fromDate} AND mur.mb_request_date < #{toDate} ) RESULT_TB ORDER BY mb_request_date ${selectOrderBy} LIMIT ${dataCnt}, ${dataPerPage}

SELECT COUNT(mur.mbid) AS approvalTotal , COUNT(CASE WHEN mur.mb_status IN ('03') THEN 1 END) AS waitCnt , COUNT(CASE WHEN mur.mb_status IN ('04', '05', '41') THEN 1 END) AS completeCnt , COUNT(CASE WHEN mur.mb_status IN ('04', '05') AND mm.adj_yn = "N" THEN 1 END) AS acceptCnt , COUNT(CASE WHEN mur.mb_status IN ('04', '05') AND mm.adj_yn = "Y" THEN 1 END) AS rearrangeCnt , COUNT(CASE WHEN mur.mb_status IN ('41') THEN 1 END) AS refuseCnt , IFNULL(ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN mur.mb_status IN ('41') THEN 1 END)/COUNT(CASE WHEN mur.mb_status IN ('04', '05', '41') THEN 1 END)*100,1), "0") AS refusePercent FROM MONEYBANK_USER_REQUEST mur LEFT JOIN CBCI_USER cu ON mur.user_code = cu.USER_CODE LEFT JOIN MONEYBANK_MONEYPLUS mm ON mur.mbid = mm.mbid WHERE mur.mb_status IN (${status}) AND mm.adj_yn IN (${adj_yn}) AND UPPER(cu.USER_NM) LIKE UPPER('${userNmSearch}%') AND UPPER(cu.FIRM_NM) LIKE UPPER('${firmNmSearch}%') AND UPPER(cu.USER_ID) LIKE UPPER('${userIdSearch}%') AND UPPER(mur.mb_product_code) LIKE UPPER('${selectDivSearch}%') AND mur.mb_request_date >= #{fromDate} AND mur.mb_request_date < #{toDate}

SELECT mur.mbid , cu.USER_NM , cu.USER_ID , cu.FIRM_NM , cu.USER_PHONE , csc1.SELECT_NM AS BUSINESS_TYPE , csc2.SELECT_NM AS SECTORS , TRUNCATE(TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, cu.FIRM_SETUP_DATE, NOW()),1) AS periodYear , SUBSTR(TRUNCATE(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MONTH, cu.FIRM_SETUP_DATE, NOW())/12,1), -1) AS periodMonth , TRUNCATE(mur.mb_sales_amount/1000,0) AS mb_sales_amount , DATE_FORMAT(mur.mb_approval_date, '%Y/%m/%d %H:%m') AS mb_approval_date , DATE_FORMAT(mur.mb_request_date, '%Y/%m/%d') AS mb_request_date , mur.mbid , mur.mb_status , mm.fee_rate , mm.payment_rate , TRUNCATE(mm.sales_limit_per_case/1000,0) AS sales_limit_per_case , adj_fee_rate , adj_payment_rate , TRUNCATE(mm.adj_sales_limit_per_case/1000,0) AS adj_sales_limit_per_case , adj_reason , IFNULL(ppr.prizm_score, '-') AS pcs_score , IfNULL(ppr.cb_score_current, '-') AS cb_score_current FROM MONEYBANK_USER_REQUEST mur LEFT JOIN CBCI_USER cu ON mur.user_code = cu.USER_CODE LEFT JOIN MONEYBANK_MONEYPLUS mm ON mur.mbid = mm.mbid LEFT JOIN PRIZM_PCS_RESULT ppr ON ppr.mbid = mur.mbid LEFT JOIN CBCI_SELECT_CODE csc1 ON csc1.SELECT_CD = cu.BUSINESS_TYPE AND csc1.SELECT_CLASS = 'biztype' LEFT JOIN CBCI_SELECT_CODE csc2 ON csc2.SELECT_CD = cu.BUSINESS_TYPE AND csc2.SELECT_CLASS = 'CBCI_SECTOR' WHERE mur.mbid = #{mbid}
SELECT GROUP_CONCAT((SELECT cc.CODE_NM FROM CBCI_CODE cc WHERE cc.CODE_ID = murs.mb_request_shop_type)) AS shop_list FROM MONEYBANK_USER_REQUEST_SHOP murs WHERE murs.mbid = #{mbid}
mapper.update: UPDATE MONEYBANK_MONEYPLUS SET adj_yn = #{adj_yn}, adj_fee_rate = #{adj_fee_rate}, adj_payment_rate = #{adj_payment_rate}, adj_sales_limit_per_case = #{adj_sales_limit_per_case}, adj_reason = #{adj_reason} WHERE mbid = #{mbid}
mapper.select: SELECT FOUND_ROWS() AS CNT , RESULT_TB.* FROM ( SELECT @BOARD_ROWNUM := @BOARD_ROWNUM + 1 AS RNUM , DATE_FORMAT(mur.mb_contract_date,'%Y-%m-%d') AS contract_date , CASE WHEN (mur.mb_product_code = 'MP') THEN '머니플러스' ELSE '' END AS mb_product_code , IFNULL(DATE_FORMAT(mur.mb_termi_date,'%Y-%m-%d'), DATE_FORMAT(mur.mb_contract_expire_date,'%Y-%m-%d')) AS expire_date , mm.fee_rate , ppr.prizm_score , pmr.pms_score FROM MONEYBANK_USER_REQUEST mur LEFT JOIN MONEYBANK_MONEYPLUS mm ON mur.mbid = mm.mbid LEFT JOIN PRIZM_PCS_RESULT ppr ON mur.mbid = ppr.mbid LEFT JOIN PRIZM_PMS_RESULT pmr ON mur.mbid = pmr.mbid , (SELECT @BOARD_ROWNUM := 0) ROWNUM_TB WHERE (mur.mb_contract_expire_date < now() OR mur.mb_termi_date < now()) AND mur.user_code = #{USER_CODE} ) RESULT_TB

SELECT FOUND_ROWS() AS CNT , RESULT_TB.* FROM( SELECT @BOARD_ROWNUM := @BOARD_ROWNUM + 1 AS RNUM , mur.mbid , cu.USER_CODE , mur.mb_status , DATE_FORMAT(mur.mb_approval_date,'%y/%m/%d') AS mb_approval_date , cu.USER_NM , cu.FIRM_NM , CASE WHEN (mur.mb_product_code = 'MP') THEN '머니플러스' ELSE '' END AS mb_product_code , IFNULL(ppr.prizm_score, '-') AS pcs_score , (SELECT COUNT(mbid) FROM MONEYBANK_USER_REQUEST_SHOP WHERE mbid = mur.mbid) AS request_shop , TRUNCATE(mur.mb_sales_amount/1000,0) AS mb_sales_amount , IF(adj_yn = 'N', mm.fee_rate, mm.adj_fee_rate) AS fee_rate , IF(adj_yn = 'N', mm.payment_rate, mm.adj_payment_rate) AS payment_rate , IFNULL(DATE_FORMAT(mur.mb_contract_date,'%y/%m/%d'), '-') AS mb_contract_date , '-' AS estimated_amount FROM MONEYBANK_USER_REQUEST mur LEFT JOIN CBCI_USER cu ON mur.user_code = cu.USER_CODE LEFT JOIN MONEYBANK_MONEYPLUS mm ON mur.mbid = mm.mbid LEFT JOIN PRIZM_PCS_RESULT ppr ON ppr.mbid = mur.mbid , (SELECT @BOARD_ROWNUM := 0) ROWNUM_TB WHERE (mur.mb_status BETWEEN '04' AND '07' OR mur.mb_status = '81') AND UPPER(cu.USER_NM) LIKE UPPER('${userNmSearch}%') AND UPPER(cu.FIRM_NM) LIKE UPPER('${firmNmSearch}%') AND UPPER(mur.mb_product_code) LIKE UPPER('${selectDivSearch}%') AND mur.mb_status LIKE ('${status}%') AND mur.mb_approval_date >= #{fromDate} AND mur.mb_approval_date < #{toDate} ) RESULT_TB ORDER BY mb_approval_date ${selectOrderBy} LIMIT ${dataCnt}, ${dataPerPage}

SELECT COUNT(mur.mbid) AS contractTotal , COUNT(CASE WHEN mur.mb_status IN ('04', '05') THEN 1 END) AS acceptCnt , COUNT(CASE WHEN mur.mb_status IN ('06') THEN 1 END) AS contractCnt , COUNT(CASE WHEN mur.mb_status IN ('07') THEN 1 END) AS endCnt FROM MONEYBANK_USER_REQUEST mur LEFT JOIN CBCI_USER cu ON mur.user_code = cu.USER_CODE WHERE (mur.mb_status BETWEEN '04' AND '07' OR mur.mb_status = '81') AND UPPER(cu.USER_NM) LIKE UPPER('${userNmSearch}%') AND UPPER(cu.FIRM_NM) LIKE UPPER('${firmNmSearch}%') AND UPPER(mur.mb_product_code) LIKE UPPER('${selectDivSearch}%') AND mur.mb_status LIKE ('${status}%') AND mur.mb_approval_date >= #{fromDate} AND mur.mb_approval_date < #{toDate}
